body:
I was surprised that there was no mention of centralized logging, even for L3.  Considering that one the requirements in a previous section was to clear sensitive data from memory, an attacker with this type of access would delete the logs as well.

8.2 - 4.8 says that all access controls fail securely and is a L1 requirement yet is 8.2 applies only to L2 and L3

8.3 - Why just the ability and not make it mandatory?  I think it should be mandatory, especially as this is specific to L2 & L3 applications

8.8 and 8.9 - I’m not sure why these aren't L2 as well
title: V8: Error Handling and logging verification requirements comments/enhancements
